name: Pangolin Addon (CLI)
description: Installs the official Pangolin CLI on the Proxmox host or an existing LXC and runs Site mode (`pangolin up site`) and/or Machine Client mode (`pangolin up client`).

notes.text: Components: Site tunnel (userspace WireGuard, no TUN) and Machine client (needs /dev/net/tun). Target: Proxmox host or an existing Debian 12+/Ubuntu 22.04+/Alpine 3.20+ LXC.
Run on the Proxmox host, not inside a container. A host install exposes everything the host can reach and joins the whole host to the VPN; prefer an existing LXC.
Site mode: use Site ID + secret, or a provisioning key (tier3/enterprise; Settings → Provisioning → Keys). Unattended needs "approve new sites" on, or approve during provisioning.
Client mode: create a machine client in the dashboard, then supply its ID, secret, and endpoint. Needs /dev/net/tun; the addon adds TUN passthrough to an LXC.
Config: /etc/pangolin/site.json and /etc/pangolin/pangolin-client.env (0600); CLI at /usr/local/bin/pangolin is sha256-verified. Update: re-run tools/addon/add-pangolin.sh.
Unattended: `var_mode=site var_target=host var_pangolin_endpoint=https://pangolin.example.com var_site_id=ID var_site_secret=SECRET` when running tools/addon/add-pangolin.sh.
